company.name: Proliferate
company.shortDescription: Proliferate provides fractional sales leadership, sales coaching, and consulting on sales operations, customer retention, and growth.
company.description: Proliferate provides sales leadership consulting for companies with complex, consultative products and services. The company offers interim and fractional sales leadership to bridge leadership gaps and guide revenue strategy. It provides coaching for sales leaders on topics such as performance management, sales training, objection handling, and executive presence. Proliferate designs and evaluates sales operations, including CRM optimization, incentive and compensation plans, and account management and customer success programs focused on retention and client growth. The firm also supports outsourced sales program design, covering lead generation, pipeline management, and territory or segment coverage. Its services are intended for owners and leaders seeking structured approaches to improve sales effectiveness and revenue growth.
